payload.text: hv's ruling of 2026-11-02 in vc's window, the go received before the clock read 06:28Z by date -u (the switch commit's own stamp): this checkout pushes to local and upstream as ordinary remotes; archive, hv's private copy of the old local, takes pushes only and is never fetched or pulled from; and the workroom goes public with the product (hv: "I'm happy for the intent/ dir to go to gh"). Executed at 06:28Z by vc's switch.sh, run by hv after two dry runs on a full copy, with a bundle of every ref and an intent backup taken first: archive took the old main as private-main at d7bb22784b45 with the 17 bank refs and the 20 old tags; main moved onto GitHub's history by reset --soft, no file on disk changed, and the workroom was committed through the gate as be65353e6911 over the 0.1.19 snapshot 0b5e4fa0f540, its tree equal to d7bb22784b45's; the 20 old tags here gave way to GitHub's v0.1.18 and v0.1.19; GitHub fast-forwarded to be65353e6911, and local's and archive's main were forced to it once, local's tags pruned to the two. Every sha in the records before today names a commit in archive's history. This supersedes decisions 52 and 56 and closes hold 34. Next: devbin's own release config takes the core's standard shape (no publish.url, no snapshot; remotes local and upstream) before any cut, since today's cut refuses a remote naming the public repository. Then hv's TUI answers in vc's window (before the clock read 06:41Z by date -u), each as vc recommended: the workroom stays public although it names hv's non-public projects, which vc had not checked before the switch (465 files; Intent's public repository already names the same projects), so decision 78 (issue 0242) now governs the shipped files alone, and they still comply; and archive's push-only rule is enforced by git, on dc's catch: remote.archive has no fetch refspec, tagOpt --no-tags and skipFetchAll true, so no fetch brings its old refs or tags back.
